title: GPU Utilization % (nvidia-smi SM active) · Inference Queue Depth / Request Latency
prompt: You are deploying an ML microservice in Kubernetes with GPU autoscaling (HPA/KEDA). Why is **GPU Utilization % (`nvidia-smi` SM active)** a misleading autoscaling metric compared to **Inference Queue Depth / Request Latency**, and how do you handle the 90-second cold-start time of loading a 30GB model weight file from S3/disk into GPU VRAM?
